## Problem
5 directives call Finnhub's API directly on every scoring run instead of querying stored database tables. This means:
- Every scoring run hits external APIs (wasting rate limits)
- When Finnhub is down, these directives fail with warnings
- Data evaporates — not stored for backtesting or analysis
- Inconsistent with 86 other directives that correctly read from DirectiveInput

## The 5 Offending Directives

| Directive | Calls Finnhub | Has DB Table? | Fix |
|-----------|--------------|---------------|-----|
| earnings-momentum | /calendar/earnings | ✅ EarningsEvent | Swap API call for Prisma query |
| news-sentiment | /news | ✅ NewsArticle | Swap API call for Prisma query |
| social-buzz | /social-sentiment | ❌ No table | Create SocialMention table + import job |
| insider-activity | /insider-transactions | ❌ No table | Create InsiderTransaction table + import job |
| dilution-impact | /company-metrics | ❌ No table | Create ShareCount table + import job |

## Acceptance
- [ ] All 5 directives read from database tables (zero external API calls)
- [ ] Missing tables created in Prisma schema
- [ ] Import jobs run periodically to populate new tables
- [ ] Directives return neutral with confidence=0 when DB data is missing
- [ ] No more 'Finnhub disabled' warnings during scoring
